   10        ORG  45000
   20        ENT  $
   30        JP   DISK
   40 TX_I   LD   BC,#BFFD
   50        LD   D,255
   60        LD   E,127
   70        EXX
   80        LD   BC,#FFFD
   90        LD   D,7
  100        LD   H,14
  110        LD   L,15
  120        OUT  (C),D
  130        EXX
  140        OUT  (C),D
  150        EXX
  160        OUT  (C),L
  170        EXX
  180        LD   A,2
  190        OUT  (C),A
  200        EXX
  210        OUT  (C),D
  220        EXX
  230        OUT  (C),E
  240        EXX
  250        OUT  (C),L
  260 TX_I_1 IN   A,(C)
  270        RRA
  280        JR   NC,TX_I_1
  290        OUT  (C),D
  300        EXX
  310        OUT  (C),D
  320        EXX
  330        OUT  (C),L
  340        EXX
  350        XOR  A
  360        OUT  (C),A
  370        EXX
  380        OUT  (C),H
  390        EXX
  400        OUT  (C),E
  410        EXX
  420        OUT  (C),L
  430 TX_I_2 IN   A,(C)
  440        RRA
  450        JR   C,TX_I_2
  460        EXX
  470        RET
  480 TX
  490        CALL TX_I
  500 TX_0   EXX
  510        OUT  (C),D
  520        EXX
  530        OUT  (C),D
  540        EXX
  550        OUT  (C),H
  560        EXX
  570        LD   A,(IX+0)
  580        INC  IX
  590        OUT  (C),A
  600        EXX
  610        OUT  (C),L
  620        EXX
  630        LD   A,2
  640        OUT  (C),A
  650        EXX
  660        OUT  (C),D
  670        EXX
  680        OUT  (C),E
  690        EXX
  700        OUT  (C),L
  710 TX_1   IN   A,(C)
  720        RRA
  730        JR   NC,TX_1
  740        OUT  (C),D
  750        EXX
  760        OUT  (C),D
  770        EXX
  780        OUT  (C),L
  790        EXX
  800        XOR  A
  810        OUT  (C),A
  820        EXX
  830        OUT  (C),D
  840        EXX
  850        OUT  (C),D
  860        EXX
  870        OUT  (C),L
  880 TX_2   IN   A,(C)
  890        RRA
  900        JR   C,TX_2
  910        EXX
  920        DEC  HL
  930        LD   A,H
  940        OR   L
  950        JP   NZ,TX_0
  960        RET
  970 DISK   LD   C,#18
  980        CALL 15635
  990        LD   DE,0
 1000        LD   B,40
 1010 DISK_1 PUSH BC
 1020        PUSH DE
 1030        LD   B,64
 1040        LD   C,5
 1050        LD   HL,49152
 1060        CALL 15635
 1070        LD   IX,49152
 1080        LD   HL,16384
 1090        CALL TX
 1100        POP  DE
 1110        POP  BC
 1120        LD   A,D
 1130        ADD  A,4
 1140        LD   D,A
 1150        DJNZ DISK_1
 1160        RET
